name: print-social-purple-yellow-event-app-hand-holding-phone-flyer
title: Lagos Events App Flyer with Raised Phone
whatItIs: A cream and purple portrait flyer where a person lifts a phone showing event listings, above diagonal photo slices of happy crowds in purple and sepia tones, with a bold purple headline, orange sub-line and social footer.
whatItMeans: Diagonal photo slices and a lively pose give a party-like energy. Purple and orange feel vibrant and youthful.
techniques: Diagonal slicing of photos into wedges
Duotone purple treatment on one crowd photo
Cut-out figure with a raised phone breaking the frame
Bold two-colour headline with orange call to action
White rounded footer panel with social handles
bestFor: Social promos with people and product

vocabulary.definition: A photo cropped into a triangular or diagonal slice.
A subject extending beyond its container for depth.
A rounded base strip holding contacts and handles.
